note: WDLL 51. Base-zone scalar rows from UDC Table 310-1, ?35-310.01, public official table at https://sanantonio-tx.elaws.us/code/udc_artiii_div2_sec35-310.01 with the City Information Bulletin rendering at https://docsonline.sanantonio.gov/FileUploads/DSD/IB565.pdf (accessed 2026-07-23). side_corner_ft mirrors the base side value only as a non-binding sentinel because Table 310-1 has no separate corner-side column; height and cover fields are likewise non-binding sentinels where the cited table extract does not provide a scalar field. OMITTED: RP; commercial/industrial/special/downtown/overlay codes; zero-lot-line variants; reversed-corner, platted-restriction, alley, adjacency, and height-increase conditions in ??35-373 and 35-515?517. ADDED 2026-07-23: C-1, C-2, C-3, O-2, I-1, and I-2 scalar base-zone rows from Table 310-1. C-3NA and C-3R use the guarded C-3 prefix match. Table 310-1 conditions side/rear setbacks on abutting residential zoning/use and removes the rear requirement for specified alley or same-district conditions; this scalar model retains the tabulated residential-adjacency value and notes the conditional rule. P-299 OT-1 (height-flag reconciliation, 2026-09-17): every max_height_ft row in this file that carried not_specified was re-read against its own provenance quote and classified with this repo's not_specified-meaning instrument (doc_repo scripts/corpus_not_specified_audit.py, OPS-21-R1). SENTINEL NORMALIZED to the canonical 999 (rule G7) -- the row's own quote states no feet-based limit (stories-only, "none", an absent height subsection, or a placeholder-shaped value in a mixed group), so the flagged number was a placeholder a flag-dropping reader would take for a real height: RE San Antonio base district (100 -> 999); R-20 San Antonio base district (100 -> 999); R-6 San Antonio base district (100 -> 999); R-5 San Antonio base district (100 -> 999); R-4 San Antonio base district (100 -> 999); R-3 San Antonio base district (100 -> 999); RM-6 San Antonio base district (100 -> 999); RM-5 San Antonio base district (100 -> 999); RM-4 San Antonio base district (100 -> 999); MF-18 San Antonio base district (100 -> 999); MF-25 San Antonio base district (100 -> 999); MF-33 San Antonio base district (100 -> 999); MF-40 San Antonio base district (100 -> 999); MF-50 San Antonio base district (100 -> 999); MF-65 San Antonio base district (100 -> 999); I-1 San Antonio light industrial district (100 -> 999); I-2 San Antonio heavy industrial district (100 -> 999). OF THOSE, RECORDED AS RESIDUALLY UNCERTAIN (placeholder-shaped value inside a group of real transcribed values; the value is not quotable in feet from the text read here, so the canonical sentinel is carried rather than a guess -- this is an adjudication, not a re-read at source, and is the first thing to re-check if a limit later surfaces): RE San Antonio base district; R-20 San Antonio base district; R-6 San Antonio base district; R-5 San Antonio base district; R-4 San Antonio base district; R-3 San Antonio base district; RM-6 San Antonio base district; RM-5 San Antonio base district; RM-4 San Antonio base district; MF-18 San Antonio base district; MF-25 San Antonio base district; MF-33 San Antonio base district; MF-40 San Antonio base district; MF-50 San Antonio base district; MF-65 San Antonio base district; I-1 San Antonio light industrial district; I-2 San Antonio heavy industrial district. FLAG REMOVED, VALUE KEPT -- here the FLAG was the defect and the number was real; not_specified on these rows asserted a false absence. The basis is stated PER ROW because it is not the same for all of them: for these rows the quote names the tabulated height column without restating the number, so the basis is the OPS-21-R1 / P-146 instrument's classification REAL_VALUE_FLAGGED -- the values across that row's flagged siblings are VARIED (transcribed numbers, not one uniform placeholder), which is the discriminator the ruling names (C-1 San Antonio commercial district (keeps 25); C-2 San Antonio commercial district (keeps 25); C-3 San Antonio commercial district (keeps 35); O-2 San Antonio office district (keeps 80)).
